verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents scheduled tasks that run on a recurring schedule using cron syntax. The schedules sync on dev/deploy and can be created, edited, disabled and deleted in the dashboard without redeploying. A community user independently reports that the scheduled task feature 'just works exactly as expected'. Missing for 10: no evidence of AI-native schedule management (e.g., creating schedules via the MCP server or by an agent), and no documented detail on timezone handling or programmatic schedule APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: A task that is triggered on a recurring schedule using cron syntax.
Create, activate, disable, edit and delete schedules in the dashboard without having to deploy any new code.
Add schedules to your tasks which sync when you run dev or deploy
The scheduled task feature has been a lifesaver—super simple and just works exactly as expected.
